items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: When Chris Kelly was at the Gypsy Tee Room, he was over there. Yeah, I think I did hear him.

ctx.x: Titi. He was a show drummer, but he was at the Nighthawk, crossing the car, you understand? Yeah, by the Nighthawk, yeah. That's right. When Chris Kelly was at the Gypsy Tee Room, he was over there. Yeah, I think I did hear him.
He had that Tee Room. We used to go to the Nighthawk somewhere and leave the Gypsy Tee Room at night.
